title: Move the ledger to cursor pagination

steps.text: The ledger pages with OFFSET, so a row written mid-scroll shifts every page after it and the operator sees the same entry twice. A keyed cursor fixes that properly.
Four call sites, all `LIMIT ? OFFSET ?`. Starting with the cursor codec, since every one of them needs it.

todos.content: Convert the four LIMIT/OFFSET call sites
todos.activeForm: Converting the four LIMIT/OFFSET call sites

input.description: page the summary's history from a cursor

steps.text: Two of the four are converted. Before I do the remaining pair, there are two contract calls here I should not make on my own - both are visible to anyone using the API.

questions.question: What should a caller get when it sends a cursor this build cannot decode?

options.label: 400 with an error
options.description: refuse it loudly, so a client bug surfaces at the call site instead of looking like an empty result

options.label: Restart from the first page
options.description: treat an undecodable cursor as absent - forgiving, but a paging bug then reads as an infinite list

questions.question: Should the page size stay caller-controlled?

options.label: Caller-controlled, capped at 100
options.description: keep the existing limit parameter and clamp it

options.label: Fixed at 50
options.description: drop the parameter, so every page is the same size and cursors stay comparable

steps.text: Got it. Refusing an undecodable cursor with a 400, and keeping the limit caller-controlled with a cap. Converting the last two call sites now.
All four call sites are on the cursor and the suite is green.
